about_the_game:
This Cyberpop Pack includes 34 Cyber-inspired Clothing Items, 5 Cyber-inspired Wigs, 5 Cyber-inspired Pets, 1 Cyber-inspired Mount, and 15 different Furniture Items.

!INCOMING CYBER TRANSMISSION! In this Cyberpop Pack you’ll find an assortment of outfits and gadgets to take you a century (or five) into the future.

Pack includes:

  • Cyberpop Furniture Set including: Chairs, a Table, Chests, a Couch, a Wardrobe, a Bed, a Rug, and Decorations
  • Hoverboard Mount
  • S.1.F.E.R, the Cyber Pet
  • QU4CK, the Cyberduck Pet
  • MOUS3 the Robotic Mouse Pet
  • Ellis, the Mascot Pet
  • Lewey, the Mascot Pet
  • 10 Cyberpop Outfit Sets including: 15 Hats and Wigs, 11 Shirts, 3 Gloves, and 10 Pants
